_how_this_works: Keywords are set PER REEL, the same way Julia sets them in LinkDM. The same word can mean different things on different days, so nothing is assumed. Her twice-daily sweep reads LinkDM and writes each new reel's entry into 'posts' below. A reel with no entry is left completely alone.
_pilot: Empty, so every reel that has a mapping is worked on. While pilot_post_ids has anything in it, ONLY those posts are touched - put an id back in it to test on one reel.
reply_template: Here you go: {link} See you in the garage! Julia
_threads_reply_note: How a LinkDM message becomes a Threads reply. LinkDM allows 900 characters; Threads allows 500 and counts every URL in full. So the message is cut, never truncated: keep the free thing the reel promised, keep the product link, keep the guide, keep 'See you in the garage! Julia'. Drop the two catch-all links (the bare stan.store profile and the lnk.bio page) - they are in her bio anyway. Swap any long URL for its short form in 'short_links' below. A PDF attached in LinkDM cannot be sent on Threads at all, so the link to it has to carry the whole job.

_evergreen_note: Only for offers whose link genuinely never changes. If there is any doubt, leave it out and let the per-reel mapping handle it. A keyword here is used ONLY when the reel has no entry of its own.
_template_note: A reel can carry its own 'template' next to its keyword. When present it is sent verbatim, so a reel can have as many links and as much wording as fits. Threads allows 500 characters for a reply and counts full URLs, so the script refuses to send anything longer rather than truncating it.
